name: Sudan
value: Drone strikes in Darfur; Kordofan battles
summary: Drone strikes kill civilians in Darfur; army advances in West Kordofan; FEWS NET sees Famine risk in besieged towns
state: Darfur24 reported a suspected army drone strike on a market west of Kabkabiya, North Darfur, on 8 Nov that killed at least two people, citing medical and local sources. Sudan Tribune reported army and allied advances against the RSF in West Kordofan around 7–8 Nov. FEWS NET assesses a credible risk of Famine in parts of North Darfur and around besieged Kadugli and Dilling in South Kordofan, which with continuing drone strikes on civilians keeps the Alert.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan. People with family in Darfur or Kordofan face disrupted communications and aid access; UN agencies and the Sudanese Red Crescent coordinate relief.
rubric_hit: Alert: sieges (Kadugli, Dilling) and famine risk spreading, per FEWS NET
